//: Acknowledgements that a counted architecture file changed WITHOUT the census being re-measured. Read by src/scripts/checkCensusFreshness.ts. An entry names the census, the head_commit it was written against (`since`), the FILES it covers, and why those changes cannot have moved a verdict. It covers the paths it names and nothing else — a counted file that changed and is not listed in `files` makes the census stale again, and an entry with no `files` covers nothing. It is spent the moment that census is re-measured: the checker compares `since` against the census head_commit and FAILS on a mismatch, so an acknowledgement cannot outlive the measurement it was written for. A second array, `retired`, holds acknowledgements whose census was later re-declared at a reachable commit: the checker does not read it, and it exists so that the per-file argument that justified the re-declaration survives the entry that carried it.
